# Lab 1.8: Query History & Reference Panel

## What We Are Going to Do
Find old jobs in personal and project history, rerun them, and use the Reference panel to build queries faster.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Personal history.** At the bottom of Studio, open **Personal history**. Click a job from Lab 1.3 and choose **Open as new query**. Run it again.

2. **[Console] Project history.** Switch to **Project history** to see jobs from everyone in the project (needs BigQuery Admin or Resource Viewer).

3. **[Console] Reference panel.** In a new query tab, open the **Reference** panel on the right. Search for `usa_1910_current`. Click the table to see the schema, then click a field name to insert it into the editor.

4. **[Console] Insert snippets.** From the Reference panel, use **Query table** to insert a starter `SELECT` for the table.

5. **[CLI] List jobs and read job metadata with SQL.**

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Personal history | Your jobs, ready to reopen |
| Project history | All users' jobs (with the right role) |
| Reference panel | Field names inserted with one click |
| JOBS_BY_USER | Same history, queryable with SQL |
